messages: I opened the package today and found a phone case inside, but I was expecting the charging cable I bought. Could you help me get the right one?
The box came this morning, but it has a blue sweater in it instead of the black one I selected.
Hi, I received a set of coffee mugs, though my receipt says I purchased a desk lamp. Can you let me know how to fix this?
I think my parcel got mixed up with someone else’s. There’s a pair of running shoes inside, and I was waiting for a backpack.
Just unpacked my delivery and it’s a different book from the one I chose. The packing slip has the title I wanted, though.
The package showed up, but the contents don’t match my checkout: I got a 10-pack of pens rather than the notebook.
I received a small dog bed, but I don’t have a dog—I was supposed to get the kitchen scale. Please advise.
My delivery had a red water bottle in it. I’d bought the stainless steel travel mug, so I’m not sure what happened.
The box contains printer paper, not the ink cartridges I was expecting. Could someone check whether the correct product is still on its way?
I got the wrong board game in my parcel. I was looking forward to the space-themed one, but this is a word game.

I opened the shipment and found a pack of tea instead of the ceramic planter I selected. What should I do next?
